name: railyard
description: Publishing review gates, delivery through consumer verification, specialist reviews, and optional fleet coordination.

interface.shortDescription: Delivery, publishing checks, and optional fleet coordination
interface.longDescription: Railyard guides local publishing review and carries authorized delivery through the repository’s merge process, required release or deployment, and consumer verification. Compound Engineering coordinates PR review and CI. Fleet coordination and specialist reviews are available on demand.
